description: In relay_client.rs, do_deliver wraps the entire SMTP session (connect + TLS + EHLO + MAIL FROM + RCPT TO + DATA + body transfer + final response) in a 30-second OPERATION_TIMEOUT. A 10 MB message over a 1 Mbit/s link requires ~80 seconds of DATA transfer alone. The timeout will fire during body transfer and the delivery will fail transiently, causing repeated queue retries that never succeed. Fix: separate the connection/handshake timeout from the data-transfer timeout, or make the timeout proportional to message size.
title: smtp: 30s OPERATION_TIMEOUT too short for large messages on slow links
